cohort: The study population consisted of nursing mothers of infants aged six months and below who presented to the child health clinic in General Hospital Bonny.
finding: Exclusive breastfeeding duration and abandonment were significantly associated with several maternal variables (parity, antenatal attendance, breastfeeding counselling, birth interval, gestational age, mode of delivery) and socio-demographic characteristics (maternal occupation, income, education, marital status).
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was found to have a significant statistical association with the duration of exclusive breastfeeding.
cross-section timing: When infants were six months old or younger
